retrievalLimitations: No general official ruling for every multistep attached-card interaction was newly obtained.
No PTCG Live behavior, Japanese, Asian, Pocket or community material is treated as international rules authority.
Every real card remains disabled until its own official text, legality and timing are audited.
implementationLimits: Supports a server-captured CHOSEN_POKEMON host for private-zone reviewed Energy/Tool attachment and public discard/return/move Energy plus discard/return Tool continuations.
The host owner, card instance and in-play entry sequence are revalidated before the attachment-card transaction commits.
Multi-host allocation, replacement effects and last-known information remain unsupported.
